'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

Searching the chest displays the chatbox message "The chest is locked! An inscription on the chest says: Property of Clock Tower Monastery.", hinting that the key to open it is dropped by the [[monk]]s in the [[Ardougne Monastery]].
